# Claude Skill Scaffold Generator

> Describe what a Claude Agent Skill should do and get a starter SKILL.md with valid frontmatter, a folder layout and authoring checks. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/claude-skill-scaffold-generator/)
